note: Hashes and provenance for reads taken from my own unit. The raw files stay in $FWRE_WORK/dumps and are never committed - see README.md in this directory for the two independent reasons.

reads.interface: CP2102 USB-TTL on the 4-pin UART header
reads.settings: 38400 8N1, no flow control, VCC not connected
reads.corroborated_by: an independent decode of the same line by a logic analyser (Async Serial @ 38400); the two transcripts are byte-identical
reads.notes: No MAC address and no WPS PIN appear in this particular log, which was not the expectation going in. Substantive content is quoted in notes/uart-findings.md.

reads.capture: ESC streamed across power-on to interrupt the boot loader
reads.notes: The <RealTek> prompt and the command set returned by '?'. See notes/uart-pinout.md section 4.

flash_reads.interface: boot loader FLR+DB over the 38400 console - no SOIC-8 clip, no programmer
flash_reads.positive_control: flash 0x000000 read first; first four bytes had to be 0b f0 00 04, the value an unrelated console session recorded on 2026-08-15
flash_reads.sampled_reverify: 12 of 256 chunks re-read over the wire afterwards; all identical
flash_reads.structural_check: fwrecon flashdump - 21 hard checks against W01's derived burn addresses and the 2026-08-15 console windows, all passed. reports/flashdump-unit-2018.json
flash_reads.strongest_check: the SquashFS at 0x180000 decompresses: 161 files, 20 dirs, 88 symlinks out of 1.8 MiB of LZMA
flash_reads.not_corroborated_by: a second, independent instrument. The 2026-08-15 windows used this same FLR+DB path, so agreement with them is cross-session repeatability rather than a second route. Only a 3.3 V programmer settles it.
must_never_be_committed: vendor firmware, which this project does not redistribute
flash 0x006000-0x008000 holds this unit's MAC addresses and radio calibration
the COMPCS block at 0x00C000 is the live configuration: admin credentials, PSK, WPS PIN

in_flight.why: G2's literal wording is two reads with matching hashes. Deliberately staged through a different RAM address (0x81800000 rather than 0x81000000) so a faulty RAM region would show up as a disagreement rather than as two identical wrong answers.
in_flight.note: Same boot loader and the same FLR path, so it tests the transport and the SPI read - not whether FLR is systematically wrong.
